patch_resolves_note: The packaged patch.diff does not apply to the staged vulnerable checkout, so fixed-side validation used the authoritative n132/arvo:42539076-fix image. That fixed source preserves the synthesized named-instance count across the later CFF gate (`num_instances_before_cff=9`, `num_instances_after_cff=9`) while the downstream coordinate-copy sink still executes cleanly.
verification_limitations: The staged vulnerable checkout is a different pre-fix FreeType branch than the metadata patch branch, so `switch-fixed --patch patch.diff` failed and the fixed trace was collected from the authoritative fixed image after reapplying only the Stage 04 instrumentation patch.

The fuzz target emits repeated named-instance initialization sequences for the same PoC. Every vulnerable root event recorded the same violating `8 -> 0` CFF zeroing, and every fixed root event recorded the same preserved `9 -> 9` count, so the repeated events do not change the verified invariant answers.

nodes.description: After the vulnerable CFF gate clears `num_instances` to 0, the default-instance synthesis block repairs the local count only to 1 before the face object caches it.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `num_instances_before_default_synth=0` and `num_instances_after_default_synth=1` at `default_instance_synthesis`.

nodes.description: `TT_Get_MM_Var()` sizes `mmvar->num_namedstyles` from the stale cached count, so the packed allocation reserves fewer `FT_Var_Named_Style` slots than the real `fvar` instance loop will use.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `mmvar_namedstyle_capacity=1` while `fvar_instance_count=8` at `mmvar_capacity_setup`.

nodes.description: At the crashing `*c = FT_GET_LONG()` sink, the named-instance loop has already advanced to an index that is outside the single cached `mmvar->num_namedstyles` slot allocated for this face.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records the last `coords_write_sink` event with `write_instance_index=1` and `mmvar_namedstyle_capacity=1`.

edges.description: The zeroed `num_instances` value created by the unconditional CFF gate is the same local count that reaches the later default-instance synthesis block.
The single synthesized named-instance count is the value later cached into `face->root.style_flags >> 16` for downstream variation handling.
The face-object cache stored in `style_flags` is later reloaded as `mmvar->num_namedstyles` when `TT_Get_MM_Var()` allocates the packed `FT_MM_Var` buffer.
The same undersized `mmvar->num_namedstyles` value still governs the later named-instance coordinate copy when `TT_Get_MM_Var()` reaches the write sink.
On the overflowing named-instance iteration, the same out-of-bounds `ns->coords` pointer loaded from pseudo-`FT_Var_Named_Style` storage becomes the sink write target `c`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `namedstyle_coords_read.ns_coords_ptr == coords_write_sink.write_target_ptr == 0x50532d41` on the crashing iteration.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The CFF-only suppression must not clear `num_instances` on a variation path that later reaches `TT_Get_MM_Var()`; the count must be preserved across this gate on the witnessed TrueType/CFF precedence path.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the root CFF gate, the named-instance count that survived the validated `fvar` header must remain unchanged when the font will later allocate and copy named-instance data through the TrueType variation path.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original clears `num_instances` to 0 as soon as a `CFF` table is present, even though the same font later reaches `TT_Get_MM_Var()` and needs the real `fvar` named-instance count. The fixed original still reaches the coordinate-copy sink, but preserves the synthesized count across the guarded CFF check instead of discarding it.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace violates the required predicate at the protected sink path (`num_instances_before_cff=8`, `num_instances_after_cff=0` while `coords_write_sink` executes). The authoritative fixed image reaches the same sink genuinely with `num_instances_before_cff=9`, `num_instances_after_cff=9`, confirming the repaired guard preserves the named-instance count on the exercised path.
